title: Ohio State Fair Poster Contest
excerpt: When the poster contest was originally formed in 2024, the use of AI was permitted if explained as a part of the application process.
content_html:
When the poster contest was originally formed in 2024, the use of AI was permitted if explained as a part of the application process. However, we recognize that the use of AI has changed greatly over the last few years in ways we didn’t anticipate, and will be reevaluating the rules and processes for 2027, which will include prohibiting the use of AI. We are committed to celebrating Ohio artists, with a number of other competitions that don’t permit AI, including the fine arts exhibition, creative arts competitions, mural contest, and plein air painting.

We greatly appreciate the feedback from fairgoers so that we can ensure our contests can best celebrate Ohio artists next year and for years to come.

2026 Poster Contest

Contestants in the poster competition create unique designs that embody many of the great things that fairgoers love about the Ohio State Fair. This year in particular, we asked artists to incorporate a patriotic theme in their designs to celebrate America's 250th anniversary.

Among the 38 total entries, the top five posters will be on display in the Creative Arts Exhibits Kasich Hall during the 2026 Ohio State Fair. The winners are as follows:

  • First Place — Christin Billips, Westerville
  • Second Place — Gene Strickland, Columbus
  • Third Place — Lisa Oliver, Reynoldsburg
  • Fourth Place — Lindsay Boyd, Lewis Center
  • Fifth Place — Nikki Smetters, Hilliard

Artwork from all five finalists can be viewed below.

Entries for the 2027 Ohio State Fair Poster Competition will open in

Congratulations to the 2026 Poster Contest Top Five Place Winners

  • First Place — Christin Billips, Westerville
  • Second Place — Gene Strickland, Columbus
  • Third Place — Lisa Oliver, Reynoldsburg
  • Fourth Place — Lindsay Boyd, Lewis Center
  • Fifth Place — Nikki Smetters, Hilliard

Click on the images to the right to see all five works of art.

Guidelines and Selection Criteria:

  • Both professional and amateur artists are permitted to enter.
  • Must be a resident of Ohio.
  • Must be 18 years old.
  • One entry per person.
  • Artwork must be family friendly.
  • In effort to help celebrate America's 250th anniversary, it is recommended that artwork include a patriotic theme, whether that is using colors of the American flag or celebrating Ohio's heritage and America 250 in some way.
  • Artwork must be related to the Ohio State Fair.
  • The Fair dates (July 29 – Aug. 9, 2026) and words Ohio State Fair must be included.
    • For reference purposes, or for those who choose to include this information, 2026 will be the 171st Ohio State Fair.
  • The artist must disclose the medium of the poster.
  • Size guidelines 24 inches x 36 inches/2:3 aspect ratio. Portrait orientation required.
  • Must be able to be reproduced and must be scalable to standard poster or postcard size.
  • All entries must be submitted electronically. Submissions must be high-quality digital photographs or images of your poster. .JPGs and .PDFs are acceptable.

Awards

  • Top 5 entries will be recognized.
  • Grand Champion will receive:
    • $1,000
    • Ribbon
    • Social media recognition
    • Coordinated opportunities with local media
    • Daily access to the Ohio State Fair and tickets for family

Entrant Acknowledgment

Entrants must agree to follow the guidelines and rules set forth by the Ohio Expositions Commission. If I am a contest winner, I recognize that I must submit my original piece of art to be displayed at the Ohio State Fair. I recognize that the Ohio State Fair retains all rights to the artwork.

Terms and Conditions for Grand Champion

Upon award, the chosen artist will be required to execute an agreement with the Ohio Expositions Commission setting forth the terms and conditions. The artist will retain copyright, but full ownership of the finished selection will be transferred to the Ohio Expositions Commission. The Ohio Expositions Commission retains the right to reproduce the original artwork for sale in various forms including, but not limited to, postcards and other merchandise. The artwork can also be used as marketing and promotional material for the Ohio State Fair.

content_html_zh:
海报竞赛最初于 2024 年举办时，如果在申请过程中做出解释，则允许使用人工智能。 然而，我们认识到人工智能的使用在过去几年中以我们没有预料到的方式发生了巨大变化，并将重新评估 2027 年的规则和流程，其中包括禁止使用人工智能。 我们致力于通过许多其他不允许人工智能的比赛来庆祝俄亥俄州的艺术家，包括美术展览、创意艺术比赛、壁画比赛和户外绘画。 我们非常感谢展会观众的反馈，以便我们确保我们的比赛能够在明年和未来几年最好地庆祝俄亥俄州的艺术家。

2026年海报大赛

海报比赛的参赛者创造了独特的设计，体现了博览会观众喜爱的俄亥俄州博览会的许多伟大之处。 特别是今年，我们要求艺术家将爱国主题融入到他们的设计中，以庆祝美国成立 250 周年。

在 38 个参赛作品中，前 5 名海报将在 2026 年俄亥俄州博览会期间在创意艺术展览卡西奇大厅展出。 获奖者如下：

  • 第一名——Christin Billips，韦斯特维尔
  • 第二名——吉恩·斯特里克兰，哥伦布
  • 第三名——丽莎·奥利弗，雷诺兹堡
  • 第四名——Lindsay Boyd，刘易斯中心
  • 第五名——尼基·斯迈特斯（Nikki Smetters），希利亚德

所有五位决赛入围者的艺术作品如下所示。

2027 年俄亥俄州博览会海报竞赛的参赛作品将于

恭喜 2026 年海报大赛前五名获奖者

  • 第一名——Christin Billips，韦斯特维尔
  • 第二名——吉恩·斯特里克兰，哥伦布
  • 第三名——丽莎·奥利弗，雷诺兹堡
  • 第四名——Lindsay Boyd，刘易斯中心
  • 第五名——尼基·斯迈特斯（Nikki Smetters），希利亚德

单击右侧的图像即可查看所有五件艺术品。

指南和选择标准：

  • 专业和业余艺术家都可以进入。
  • 必须是俄亥俄州居民。
  • 必须年满 18 岁。
  • 每人只能参加一次。
  • 艺术品必须适合家庭。
  • 为了帮助庆祝美国成立 250 周年，建议艺术作品包含爱国主题，无论是使用美国国旗的颜色还是以某种方式庆祝俄亥俄州的传统和美国 250 周年。
  • 艺术品必须与俄亥俄州博览会相关。
  • 必须包含博览会日期（2026 年 7 月 29 日至 8 月 9 日）和俄亥俄州博览会字样。 出于参考目的，或者对于那些选择包含此信息的人，2026 年将是第 171 届俄亥俄州博览会。
  • 艺术家必须披露海报的媒介。
  • 尺寸指南 24 英寸 x 36 英寸/2:3 长宽比。 需要纵向。
  • 必须能够复制，并且必须可缩放至标准海报或明信片尺寸。
  • 所有参赛作品必须以电子方式提交。 提交的内容必须是高质量的数码照片或海报图像。 .JPG 和 .PDF 是可接受的。

奖项

  • 前 5 名参赛作品将被认可。
  • 总冠军将获得： 1,000 美元丝带 社交媒体认可 与当地媒体协调的机会 每日参加俄亥俄州博览会和家庭门票

参赛者致谢

参赛者必须同意遵守俄亥俄州博览会委员会制定的指导方针和规则。 如果我是比赛获胜者，我认识到我必须提交我的原创艺术品以在俄亥俄州博览会上展示。 我承认俄亥俄州博览会保留对该艺术品的所有权利。

总冠军的条款和条件

获奖后，所选艺术家将需要与俄亥俄州博览会委员会签署协议，规定条款和条件。 艺术家将保留版权，但最终选择的全部所有权将转移给俄亥俄州博览会委员会。 俄亥俄州博览会委员会保留复制原始艺术品以各种形式出售的权利，包括但不限于明信片和其他商品。 该艺术品还可以用作俄亥俄州博览会的营销和宣传材料。
